
## 6. Dán nội dung Pull Request Template

File `.github/pull_request_template.md`:

```markdown
## Summary

Describe the implementation, fix, or documentation update.

## Module

- [ ] Application FSM
- [ ] Clock
- [ ] Alarm
- [ ] Button
- [ ] 7-segment display
- [ ] Buzzer
- [ ] LED
- [ ] EEPROM
- [ ] Timer / Interrupt
- [ ] Documentation

## Verification

- [ ] Project builds successfully
- [ ] Tested on SN8F5708 EVK
- [ ] Existing functions still operate correctly
- [ ] Documentation has been updated

## Test Evidence

Describe the test steps and results. Attach images when applicable.

## Known Limitations

List any unfinished work, risks, or follow-up tasks.
